end.summary:
Dev showed the examples of Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko, including why they help nature, on a why/new-situation question.
Dev practised explaining how practices protect plants, animals, water or soil; explanations were partly right, and this needs checking again next time.
Dev first said small actions cannot help nature and only the government can protect it; this was corrected later with planting and watering ideas, though the mix-up resurfaced once.
Dev connected trees with shade, fruit, animal homes and soil protection.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko with Dev, and Dev linked them to protecting trees, animals, water and soil. Dev gave several relevant explanations; the link between grass, soil and small individual actions still needs more practice. Dev’s idea that only the government can help was corrected later by discussing planting and watering in the colony, though it came up again once. At home, ask Dev to choose one local action and explain which part of nature it protects and how.
